prerequisites.label: Skill 66 - KIE Image
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Skill 66 (66-kie-image) before Skill 28: it owns image model choice and generation.

prerequisites.label: Skill 67 - KIE Video
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Skill 67 (67-kie-video) before Skill 28: it owns the VEO video route and model id.

prerequisites.label: Skill 68 - KIE Audio
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Skill 68 (68-kie-audio) before Skill 28: it owns voice, sound-effect and music generation.

prerequisites.label: KIE API Key
prerequisites.satisfy: Add KIE_API_KEY=<your key> to ~/.openclaw/secrets/.env (chmod 600). Confirm it is SET; never print the value. Do NOT mint a new key.
